question: Should runtime i18n localize gateway JSON message/reason fields, or should those protocol-adjacent fields stay stable while only display-layer copy is localized?
rationale: The diff changes gateway-facing string fields that are typed as generic strings but may be consumed by clients; automation cannot infer whether maintainers consider them display-only contracts.

options.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Strings Stable
options.body: Preserve stable gateway error/reason text or add separate localized display fields until maintainers confirm client contracts.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Fields
options.body: Allow locale-dependent gateway message/reason strings and document that clients must key off stable code/type fields instead.

options.title: Narrow Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Land only channel/TUI display copy now and leave gateway protocol-adjacent localization for a follow-up decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Strings Stable
recommendation.body: Preserve stable gateway error/reason text or add separate localized display fields until maintainers confirm client contracts.
